reviewNotes: Twenty-three movie-theater visitor strings, one island-shrine riddle, and one pirate line were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover speaker voice, film and concession context, humor, dialogue controls, placeholders, shrine clues, verse cadence, and natural Romanian; both found no remaining objective issue.

MovieTheater_ShortsMan2.source: Corner Guy: Psst... I just saw the movie, and... Relax! I'm not going to spoil it for you.
MovieTheater_ShortsMan2.translation: Tipul din colț: Psst... Tocmai am văzut filmul și... Relaxează-te! Nu am de gând să-ți dezvălui ce se întâmplă.

MovieTheater_Mother.source: Woman: Simon, don't you want something healthy? *sigh*... okay...
MovieTheater_Mother.translation: Femeie: Simon, nu vrei ceva sănătos? *oftează*... bine...

MovieTheater_Mother2.source: Woman: How about some apple slices? No? *sigh*... okay...
MovieTheater_Mother2.translation: Femeie: Ce-ar fi să iei niște felii de măr? Nu? *oftează*... bine...

MovieTheater_Child2.source: Simon: Mom! I want chocolate popcorn! *slurp*
MovieTheater_Child2.translation: Simon: Mamă! Vreau floricele cu ciocolată! *plescăie*

MovieTheater_Lupini.source: Lupini: Amateurs! The set design was completely mundane!
MovieTheater_Lupini.translation: Lupini: Amatori! Scenografia a fost cu totul banală!

MovieTheater_Lupini2.source: Lupini: Amateurs! My nephew's 2nd birthday party home video had better cinematography!
MovieTheater_Lupini2.translation: Lupini: Amatori! Filmarea de acasă de la aniversarea de 2 ani a nepotului meu avea o imagine mai bună!

MovieTheater_ConcessionMan.source: Moviegoer: Urgh... Too many snack options!
MovieTheater_ConcessionMan.translation: Spectator: Of... Prea multe gustări din care să aleg!

MovieTheater_ConcessionMan2.source: Moviegoer: Ah, look at that popcorn go! Oh, the sounds... the smells!
MovieTheater_ConcessionMan2.translation: Spectator: Ah, uite cum sar floricelele! Oh, sunetele... mirosurile!

MovieTheater_PurpleHairLady.source: Woman: Get lost... I'm busy rubbing elbows with the Governor!
MovieTheater_PurpleHairLady.translation: Femeie: Dispari... sunt ocupată să-mi fac relații cu Guvernatorul!

MovieTheater_RedCapGuy.source: Man: Uh oh... I think I'm a little overdressed for this place...
MovieTheater_RedCapGuy.translation: Bărbat: Aoleu... Cred că m-am îmbrăcat puțin prea elegant pentru locul acesta...

MovieTheater_RedCapGuy2.source: Man: I sat in the front row... big mistake.
MovieTheater_RedCapGuy2.translation: Bărbat: M-am așezat în primul rând... mare greșeală.

MovieTheater_Governor.source: Governor: It's lovely to see economic development in the valley!
MovieTheater_Governor.translation: Guvernatorul: Este minunat să văd dezvoltarea economică a văii!

MovieTheater_Governor2.source: Governor: I really must bring the missus out for soup and a movie!
MovieTheater_Governor2.translation: Guvernatorul: Chiar trebuie să-mi scot soția la o supă și la un film!

MovieTheater_Gunther.source: Hey, I'd love to chat, but I need to head back to the museum!
MovieTheater_Gunther.translation: Hei, mi-ar plăcea să stăm de vorbă, dar trebuie să mă întorc la muzeu!

MovieTheater_Gunther2.source: Hey, @. I just saw the movie, myself... not bad!
MovieTheater_Gunther2.translation: Hei, @. Tocmai am văzut și eu filmul... nu-i rău!

MovieTheater_Marlon.source: Gil slept through the whole movie... typical.
MovieTheater_Marlon.translation: Gil a dormit pe tot parcursul filmului... tipic.

MovieTheater_Marlon2.source: That was an interesting one... what'd you think, Gil?#$b#...Gil?#$b#...He's out cold.
MovieTheater_Marlon2.translation: A fost un film interesant... tu ce părere ai, Gil?#$b#...Gil?#$b#...Doarme dus.

MovieTheater_Marcello.source: Marcello: What a spread! I think I'll go for the bourbon mayonnaise. Hehe!
MovieTheater_Marcello.translation: Marcello: Ce varietate! Cred că voi alege maioneza cu bourbon. Hehe!

MovieTheater_Marcello2.source: Marcello: What a spread! I think I'll go for the 12-grain spicy mustard. Hehe!
MovieTheater_Marcello2.translation: Marcello: Ce varietate! Cred că voi alege muștarul picant cu 12 cereale. Hehe!

MovieTheater_Morris.source: As you can see, the theater is a major success!$h#$b#Whaa...? A return on your investment? Well, it's difficult, you know... might take a while, you understand... *mumble*$2
MovieTheater_Morris.translation: După cum vezi, cinematograful este un succes răsunător!$h#$b#Cee...? Recuperarea investiției? Ei bine, este complicat, știi... s-ar putea să dureze, înțelegi... *mormăie*$2

MovieTheater_Morris2.source: Ah, it's our very important investment partner! Enjoy the show, and don't forget to buy a bag of JojaCorn on your way in!$h
MovieTheater_Morris2.translation: Ah, iată partenerul nostru de investiții foarte important! Vizionare plăcută și nu uita să cumperi o pungă de JojaCorn la intrare!$h

IslandShrine_Shrine.source: When dark clouds cry, begin your quest^To seek the fabled gem-birds four^Each day, one north, south, east, or west^Arrange their gifts upon my door
IslandShrine_Shrine.translation: Când norii negri plâng, pornește în căutare^Să găsești cele patru păsări legendare cu nestemate^În fiecare zi, câte una la nord, sud, est sau vest^Așază-le darurile la ușa mea

Pirates1.source: GREEN: You were always Momma's favorite! WaaaAaAa
Pirates1.translation: VERDE: Pe tine te-a preferat mereu mama! UaaaaAaAa
